lesson.title: Git Rebase and Resolving Merge Conflicts
lesson.goal: rebase a feature branch onto main with git and resolve the conflicts

sources.title: Git Rebase and Resolving Merge Conflicts

steps.title: Clone repo and inspect branches
steps.instructions: Clone the git-rebase-example repository into your empty workdir and switch to the feature/login branch. Run git branch -a to inspect local and remote branches before rebasing.

targets.caption: Verify you are on the feature/login branch before starting the rebase

explanations.topic: How git rebase moves commits onto a new base
Never rebase pushed commits and checking git branch -a
How rebase replays commits one by one and pauses on conflicts

hints: Make sure you clone the repository into your empty workspace folder first.
Switch to the feature branch with git checkout feature/login before running git branch -a.
Run: git clone https://github.com/philomatics/git-rebase-example.git . && git checkout feature/login && git branch -a
common_mistakes: Staying on the main branch instead of checking out feature/login before rebasing.
Forgetting to cd into the cloned directory if you did not clone into '.'.
steps.run_command: git clone https://github.com/philomatics/git-rebase-example.git . && git checkout feature/login && git branch -a

steps.title: Start rebasing feature/login onto main
steps.instructions: Run git rebase main from feature/login to replay your feature commits onto main. Inspect the paused rebase state with git status when the first conflict occurs.

targets.caption: Git pauses the rebase at the first conflicting commit on index.js

explanations.topic: Editing conflict markers and staging resolved files

hints: Which branch name should you pass to git rebase when you are already on feature/login?
Pass the target base branch name (main) to git rebase, then check git status.
Run: git rebase main followed by git status
common_mistakes: Running git rebase feature/login while on main instead of rebasing feature/login onto main.
Panicking at the conflict error and running git rebase --abort instead of resolving it.

steps.title: Resolve and stage index.js conflicts
steps.instructions: Open index.js, remove the conflict markers, keep DEFAULT_USER = "admin", and keep both the main and login routes. Save the file and stage it with git add index.js.

targets.caption: Resolve both conflict blocks in index.js and remove all conflict markers

explanations.topic: Using git rebase --continue and exiting Vim with :wq

hints: Look for <<<<<<< HEAD markers in index.js—there are two conflict sections in this file.
For DEFAULT_USER keep the incoming change ("admin"), and for the routes accept both changes so /profile, the logging middleware, and /login are all kept.
Save index.js and run: git add index.js && git status
common_mistakes: Leaving one of the <<<<<<<, =======, or >>>>>>> conflict marker lines in index.js.
Forgetting to save index.js before running git add index.js.
Running git commit instead of staging with git add for git rebase --continue.

steps.title: Continue rebase to next conflict
steps.instructions: Run git rebase --continue and save the commit message in Vim using Esc then :wq. Git applies the next commits and pauses at the package.json conflict.

targets.caption: After continuing, Git applies the next commit and pauses at package.json

hints: Unlike a regular merge, you do not run git commit during a rebase—use the rebase continue flag.
When Vim opens with COMMIT_EDITMSG, press Escape, type :wq, and press Enter to keep the existing commit message.
common_mistakes: Running git commit manually instead of git rebase --continue.
Getting stuck inside Vim or quitting without saving (:q!) instead of saving and quitting (:wq).

steps.title: Resolve package.json and finish rebase
steps.instructions: Resolve the conflict in package.json by removing the markers and keeping the check script, then stage it with git add package.json. Run git rebase --continue, save in Vim, and verify completion with git status.

targets.caption: Resolve the scripts conflict in package.json and remove all conflict markers

explanations.topic: Verifying the finished rebase with git status

hints: Open package.json and look for the conflict markers around the "check" script.
Keep "check": "node -c index.js" (or "node --check index.js"), save the file, and stage it with git add package.json.
Run git rebase --continue, exit Vim with Esc then :wq, and confirm with git status.
common_mistakes: Leaving invalid JSON syntax (such as an extra or missing comma) in package.json after removing markers.
Forgetting to run git add package.json before running git rebase --continue.
steps.run_command: git add package.json && git rebase --continue && git status
